Assistant (0.2s): Hello, this is the digital assistant of Freya Bank. We record this call. Am I speaking with Mr Ionescu?

User (1.5s): Yes, this is Victor Ionescu.

Assistant (2.3s): Thank you. Before we continue, I need to ask you two short security questions. What is your date of birth?

User (3.8s): Eleventh of August.

Assistant (5.0s): Thank you. And the year?

User (6.9s): Nineteen eighty-one.

Assistant (8.3s): Thank you. What is the last four digits of the phone number on file?

User (10.1s): Fifty-five.

Assistant (10.5s): Thank you. And the remaining 2 digits?

User (11.5s): Sixty.

Assistant (13.2s): Thank you, your identity is confirmed. I am calling from the Freya Bank collections team about a late payment. Your personal loan has a past-due amount of 2100.00, which is 28 days late. Can you make this payment today?

User (14.9s): I cannot pay that amount right now. I want lower instalments instead.

Assistant (17.9s): I will connect you to a colleague now. Thank you for your time, goodbye.
